facts.text: Hey Rock, sit down and eat. Skip the meat locker today, Adrian made a real dinner.
facts.why: Not a Paulie line. The Wikiquote page has no such line. In the Thanksgiving scene Paulie rips a leg off Adrian's turkey and tosses the bird out the back door.
facts.fix: Rock, put the beef down. Adrian cooked a turkey, and I'm taking a leg.
